Extra sounds used by Wild Tamers. Everything here is CC0 (public domain).
The music, button click, footstep and attack sounds are the project's own files in Assets/_Project/Sounds (see Resources/SoundLibrary).

Sound effects
- Sfx_Win (confirmation_002), Sfx_Lose (confirmation_001), Sfx_Pop (confirmation_003) - Kenney "Interface Sounds" (CC0)  https://opengameart.org/content/interface-sounds
- Sfx_Guard (impact.9) - "Impact" pack by StarNinjas (CC0)  https://opengameart.org/content/10-impactshield-blocks
